project.project_title: Paperback Cover: Blurb Edit & Font Consistency Fix

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
I have a small task and wanted to check whether you’re available.

• My paperback cover requires 2 minor corrections: removing a few words from the blurb and making the title font consistent across the front/spine/back. Everything else is final, and no redesign is required.
• Required outputs: layered .psd, .pdf, and .jpg
• Turnaround: within 24 hours
• Are you free to take this on?

My budget is $30.

[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

value_updates.blurb_edit: delete a few words from the existing blurb

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], thank you for responding so quickly.

This needs only two minor corrections, not a redesign:
Blurb replacement: the final paragraph has been shortened because it currently overlaps the barcode, so the revised text only needs to be inserted and reflowed.
Inconsistent title font: the front uses a bold gold-gradient font, while the spine/back use a simpler one. Please match them all to the front.
I'll provide the images, templates, and .psd.
Can you return the layered .psd, .pdf, and .jpg within 24 hours?

value_updates.layout_behavior: drop in and reflow the trimmed blurb so it does not overlap the barcode

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I'll try posting on D2D's social media, as that may prompt a quicker response.

However, I found an issue with your cover.

• The blurb revision and title font both look good and were corrected properly.
• There is one problem: the tagline at the top of the front cover ("A CHINESE HOLIDAY MURDER MYSTERY") appears as garbled, corrupted text rather than the correct wording.
• It seems like a font-substitution or encoding problem, so please inspect the font assigned to that text box.
• During the new export, please embed the fonts or outline/convert them to curves so the text does not rely on font availability and displays correctly everywhere.
• Please correct this and send the .pdf first.

Thx
C-

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the blurb edit looks good and was fixed correctly.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes, the book is 300 pages. FYI - I publish through Amazon, where the print edition is 300 pages. Draft2Digital uses Ingram for print distribution, and they added 2 pages to the book. I'm unsure whether that changes the spine. Since I cannot prevent D2D from changing the page count from 300 to 302, I am shortening the blurb. The problem is the bar code.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: As shown in the templates, D2D specifies a 0.68-inch spine, whereas Amazon specifies 0.75 inches.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Here is a screenshot.

The requested updates are complete.

The title fonts on the spine and back now match the title on the front.

The spine width has also been applied, and the complete cover now satisfies Amazon requirements.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the specified spine width was applied and the cover meets Amazon requirements.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Of course. I'm currently asking D2D whether this is a bug. For 300–302 pages printed on Cream paper, the spine should be about 0.75", which exactly matches my Amazon file. However, D2D continues to generate 0.68", even after I followed their directions to resave Step 2 and download a fresh template again. I definitely want you to fix the blurb and font, so please begin with those. I'll update you soon about the spine.

ambiguity.description: The required D2D spine width is unresolved because its template generates 0.68 inches while the client expects approximately 0.75 inches for the relevant page range.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I can't believe D2D still hasn't responded. Let's pause this until tomorrow. I'll place an order for something, although the cover specifications may or may not be correct. I will allow them one more day. Thank you for being patient. [FREELANCER_NAME_003], [CLIENT_NAME_001]

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
HI [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
Please proceed with the D2D cover using the D2D template spine width of 0.68 inches. I will modify the job to include an additional $20. I have not heard back from D2D. However, I cannot believe their template has a bug, since many authors would otherwise be complaining. Thanks,
[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]
